marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.intro: Marketing isn't an expense. It's an investmentprovided it's structured, targeted, and measurable. At ActiveRise, we design and implement marketing strategies tailored to the realities of your market, your target audience, and your objectivesfor actions that produce concrete and measurable results.

services.title: Complete marketing audit
services.description: You can't improve what you don't understand yet. We conduct an in-depth marketing analysis of your positioning, channels, actions and results. In return, you receive a precise report that identifies your real bottlenecks and growth levers to activate firstno approximations.

services.title: Marketing strategy development
services.description: Based on the diagnosis, we build a tailored marketing strategyadapted to your sector, audience and real objectives. You get a clear and operational roadmap: what to do, in what order, with what resources and for what expected results.

services.title: Positioning and target definition
services.description: Knowing who you're talking to is the foundation of any effective strategy. We help you define your ideal client precisely, understand their real challenges and position your offer in a differentiated and credible way in your market.

services.title: Marketing action plan construction
services.description: We translate your strategy into a structured and prioritized action planconcrete actions, execution schedule, responsibilities and performance indicators. Every decision is justified, every action is measurable.

services.title: Paid advertising campaign management
services.description: We design, launch and optimize your digital advertising campaigns on platforms suited to your targetMeta, Google, LinkedIn, TikTok. Each campaign is managed with precision, monitored in real-time and continuously adjusted to maximize your return on investment.

services.title: Acquisition and loyalty strategy
services.description: Attracting new customers is essential. Retaining the ones you have is just as important. We implement strategies that cover both dimensionstargeted acquisition and loyalty programsto maximize the value of every customer relationship.

services.title: Content marketing
services.description: We create and deploy a content strategy that attracts your audience, strengthens your credibility and generates qualified leadsarticles, videos, infographics, social media posts. Each piece of content has a specific purpose and a defined place in your overall strategy.

services.title: Account creation and management
services.description: We handle the creation, configuration and complete management of your accounts on the platforms most relevant to your businessFacebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok. Each profile is optimized to reflect your brand image and maximize your visibility.

services.title: Editorial production and planning
services.description: Publishing professional and consistent content regularly takes time and expertise. We create your monthly editorial calendar, produce your visuals and write your captionsfor constant, polished and strategic digital presence.

services.title: Community animation
services.description: We animate your community dailyresponding to comments and messages, creating interactions, managing reviewsto build a loyal, active and engaged audience around your brand.

services.title: Performance reporting and analysis
services.description: Each month, you receive a detailed report of your performancereach, engagement, leads generated, cost per result. We analyze the data, identify what works and adjust the strategy accordingly.

formation.title: Training
formation.description: Want to master your own marketing tools? We offer practical and operational training on managing Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads and TikTok Ads campaigns. Short, concrete and immediately applicable programsso you can launch and manage your own campaigns with efficiency and independence.

cta.title: Your growth begins
cta.text: Let's discuss your situation and identify the marketing levers that best fit your objectives. First exchange is free  no commitment.

communication_branding.title: Communication
communication_branding.intro: A strong brand is not just a beautiful logo. It rests on a clear position, coherent messaging and disciplined communication across all channels. At ActiveRise, we build the strategic foundation of your brand  what you are, what you say and how you say it  so every message reinforces your credibility and creates a lasting impression in the minds of your clients. The production of your visual assets (logo, graphic charter, design) is handled by our Creation & Web Development team.

services.title: Brand positioning definition
services.description: How do you want to be perceived by your customers? We work with you to define your brand's deeper identity  its core values, personality and customer promise  and build a clear and differentiating position that distinguishes you durably from your competitors in your market.

services.title: Institutional discourse development
services.description: Your tagline, your slogan, your key messages  every word you use to talk about your business must be chosen carefully. We build your complete institutional discourse so it is powerful, memorable and perfectly aligned with your positioning. Because a brand that speaks well is a brand that lasts.

services.title: Brand strategy
services.description: Beyond positioning, your brand needs a clear strategic direction  how to evolve, how to differentiate, how to build a lasting relationship of trust with your audience. We develop your global brand strategy and support you in implementing it coherently across all touchpoints.

services.title: Brand consistency audit
services.description: Does your communication truly reflect who you are? We analyze all your messages, media and interactions to identify inconsistencies between your brand identity and your actual communication  and provide you with a concrete and prioritized alignment plan.

services.title: Institutional communication
services.description: The way your company presents itself to the world determines the trust you inspire. We structure your institutional communication  corporate speech, official presentations, reference documents  so every message your organization delivers is professional, coherent and worthy of your ambitions.

services.title: Key message structuring
services.description: Knowing what to say isn't enoughyou also need to know how to say it, to whom and on which channel. We structure your key messages by audience and context to ensure clear, relevant and effective communicationwhether facing an investor, partner, client or your own teams.

services.title: Internal communication
services.description: A company that communicates well internally performs better externally. We help you structure your internal communication  leadership messages, company culture, team alignment  to create a coherent organization where every employee understands the vision and embraces it.

services.title: Digital communication strategy
services.description: We develop your global digital communication plan  priority channels, messages tailored to each audience, optimal frequency and performance indicators. Every decision is based on an analysis of your target and market to guarantee coherent, visible and results-generating digital communication.

services.title: Content strategy
services.description: Content is your brand's voice on digital. We define your content strategy  editorial themes, formats for each platform, publication calendar and editorial line  so every piece of content produced reinforces your positioning and engages your audience sustainably.

services.title: Event visibility strategy
services.description: Product launch, opening, conference, trade showevery event is a strategic opportunity to strengthen your image and expand your audience. We support you in designing and deploying your event communication strategy to maximize the impact and visibility of each key moment.

services.title: Crisis communication management
services.description: A sensitive situation mishandled can durably affect your company's reputation. We support you strategically in managing your communication during a crisisadapted messages, priority channels, controlled timingto preserve your credibility and the trust of your stakeholders.

formation.title: Training
formation.description: We offer practical training on the fundamentals of corporate communication, building a brand strategy, structuring key messages and institutional public speaking. Operational programs designed for executives, managers and teams who want to master their communication and strengthen their organization's image.

cta.title: Your brand has a story.
cta.text: Let's discuss your communication and brand positioning. We will identify together the adjustments that will make a difference. First exchange is free  no commitment.

creation_web.title: Web Creation & Development
creation_web.intro: Strategy without execution remains just an intention. At ActiveRise, we bring your brand to life through concrete and impactful creations  visual identity, communication materials, audiovisual productions and custom digital solutions. Every deliverable is designed with rigor, attention to detail and results-oriented approach, so your brand is seen, recognized and memorable.

services.title: Logo Design
services.description: Your logo is the first symbol of your identity. We design it with care  unique design, sense carried by every detail, adaptable to all media. A logo that resembles you, distinguishes you and stands the test of time.

services.title: Complete Brand Guidelines
services.description: The visual consistency of your brand relies on clear and shared rules. We develop your complete graphic charter  colors, typography, iconography, usage rules across all media  so every creation produced is immediately identifiable as yours.

services.title: Brand Visual Universe
services.description: Beyond the logo and guidelines, your brand has an atmosphere, a style, a graphic soul. We build the complete visual universe of your brand  reference images, textures, standard layouts, visual tone  for a strong, consistent and recognizable identity at first glance.

services.title: Print Media
services.description: Flyers, posters, banners, business cards, catalogs, brochures  we design your printed materials with rigorous attention to aesthetics, readability and visual impact. Each material is aligned with your brand identity and designed to achieve its communication objective.

services.title: Digital Materials
services.description: Advertising banners, social media visuals, presentation templates, graphic newsletters  we create your digital materials with professional finishing level, optimized for each format and distribution platform.

services.title: Advertising Creation
services.description: Effective advertising doesn't just need to be beautiful  it must convince and trigger action. We create your print and digital advertising visuals with a strategic approach  clear message, controlled visual hierarchy and integrated call to action.

services.title: Commercial Spot Production
services.description: A well-designed commercial spot can transform your company's visibility in seconds. We produce your spots from A to Z  concept, script, production and final editing  for videos that captivate, leave an impression and generate concrete results.

services.title: Video Editing & Post-Production
services.description: Do you have video footage to enhance? We handle the editing, color grading, sound design and complete post-production of your videos for a professional and impactful finish  adapted to each format and distribution platform.

services.title: Motion Design & Animation
services.description: Movement amplifies the message. We create graphic animations, opening sequences, transitions and visual effects that bring your content to life and make it more engaging  for your videos, presentations or digital ads.

services.title: Podcast Production
services.description: Podcast is a powerful tool to establish your authority and create a deep connection with your audience. We support you in the complete production of your podcast  editorial design, recording, audio editing, sound design and distribution on listening platforms.

services.title: Professional Photography
services.description: A professional image is worth a thousand sales arguments. We ensure artistic direction and photography production for your photo shoots  products, team, events or social media content  for visuals that reflect the excellence of your brand.

services.title: UX/UI Design
services.description: Before developing, you must design. We design the user experience and interface of your site or application  user journey, mockups, interactive prototypes  to ensure smooth, intuitive navigation oriented toward conversion before writing the first line of code.

services.title: Showcase & Institutional Websites
services.description: Your website works for you 24/7. We develop professional, modern and high-performing websites  custom designed, optimized for search engines and adapted to all screens  to convert your visitors into customers and strengthen your online credibility.

services.title: Online Stores (E-commerce)
services.description: Sell your products online without location or time constraints. We develop your online store with smooth shopping experience, secure payment system and simple management interface  so you can focus on your sales and growth.

services.title: Optimized Landing Pages
services.description: A well-designed landing page can significantly multiply your conversion rates. We create targeted and optimized landing pages to transform your visitors into leads or customers  ideal for your advertising campaigns, product launches or special offers.

services.title: Web & Mobile Applications
services.description: Do you have a specific need that no standard tool covers? We develop your custom web and mobile applications  iOS and Android  from user experience design to final deployment. Powerful, intuitive solutions built to meet the real needs of your users.

formation.title: Training
formation.description: We offer practical training and immediately applicable sessions to master the essential tools for creating visual content and web development.

items.title: Training  Visual Content Creation
items.description: We train you in creating professional visuals for social media and communication materials. Practical sessions immediately applicable to produce quality visual content independently.

items.title: Training  Video Editing
items.description: From shooting to publishing  we train you in essential video editing techniques to produce professional video content adapted to digital platform formats. Practical field-oriented training, accessible regardless of your starting level.

items.title: Training  Introduction to Web Development
items.description: Understand how a website works, communicate effectively with a developer and manage basic updates to your site  we offer accessible introduction to web development fundamentals for non-technical people who want to take control of their digital presence.

hero.description: Discover how we have accompanied businesses through their transformation and expansion  using a structured, results-driven approach.

case1.title: Eureka & Co
case1.sector: Hygiene, maintenance, green spaces, air conditioning
case1.context: Eureka & Co specializes in hygiene, pest control, maintenance, landscaping, and air conditioning. The business had an existing website but suffered from an insufficient, unaligned digital presence to fuel its scale.
case1.challenge: Identify digital growth levers, restructure online presence, and deploy cohesive messaging  all while satisfying a meticulous executive strict on fine details and deadlines.
case1.int1: Comprehensive audit and strategic identification of major growth channels.
case1.int2: Full custom web redesign, engineered to match the client's high standards of precision.
case1.int3: Setup, optimization, and deployment across social platforms (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn).
case1.int4: Production of a high-end commercial video covering the company's full service suite.
case1.int5: Global execution of an aligned branding and digital communication roadmap.
case1.management: Active Rise handles continuous management of Eureka & Co's ecosystem: maintenance, web updates, social media curation, content production, and monthly performance audits.
case1.res1: Fully operational custom website actively managed round-the-clock.
case1.res2: Active, highly corporate presence established across 4 major digital channels.
case1.res3: Thousands of targeted, organic views generated on published assets.
case1.res4: Overall conversion rates steadily progressing month-over-month.
case1.note: The Eureka & Co website is live online and serves as direct, verifiable proof of ActiveRise's execution quality.

case2.title: Green World Congo
case2.manager: Mr. Milandou Léandre, Top Leader Green World Congo
case2.context: Green World is an international group founded in 1994, operating in over 40 countries, specializing in natural health products sold via network marketing. For their expansion in the Republic of the Congo, the local leader sought to modernize network growth, which previously relied entirely on field contacts and flyers.
case2.challenge: Transition a 100% field-based commercial approach into a structured digital pipeline capable of massively expanding the distributor network and driving revenue in record time.
case2.int1: Analytical audit of current performance and precise mapping of growth opportunities.
case2.int2: Development of a dedicated digital acquisition workflow engineered for the MLM model.
case2.int3: Deployment of structured, professional digital communication channels.
case2.int4: Creation and rolling deployment of strategic product-focused corporate assets.
case2.int5: Production of tactical video commercials to promote the sales network.
case2.int6: Uninterrupted strategic support maintained during the leader's regional travel across Central Africa.
case2.res1: Substantial distributor network expansion: +45% within the first year.
case2.res2: Successful migration to a structured, active, and fully digital business presence.
case2.res3: Cross-border operational support continuity verified and proven.
case2.note: The +45% network expansion metric is undergoing final operational consolidation by Mr. Milandou Léandre.
